name: Figu@mate
source:
Akiba town... it's a holy place for Otaku, known as Akiba Road. Keigo is a normal Otaku, visiting Akiba Road almost every day. His current favourite is "Koisuru Silk Hat", a popular anime. He gets a figure of Memeko, one of the heroines... but a magical girl is incarnated in the figure. The girl is sent to this world because she used a forbidden magic. According to her, "semen shower" is necessary to return to her original body. He can't decide whether or not to accept her offer. And what will happen when the magical girl visits Akiba town? The figure and Otaku's strange summer starts...

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081031090832/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005514]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
秋叶町……是御宅族的圣地，被称为秋叶路。圭吾是一个普通的宅男，几乎每天都会去秋叶原路。他目前最喜欢的是热门动漫《恋爱丝帽》。他得到了女主角之一Memeko的手办……但手办中化身为魔法少女。少女因为使用了禁忌魔法而被传送到这个世界。据她介绍，要回到原来的身体，必须进行“精液沐浴”。他无法决定是否接受她的提议。当魔法少女来到秋叶原町时，会发生什么呢？身影与御宅族的奇异夏天开始了……

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081031090832/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005514]ErogeShop[/url]]
